description: Backend API template (Node 22 + Express 5 + Mongoose + Redis + Socket.IO + BullMQ, TypeScript strict): three namespaces (/customer/v1, /merchant/v1, /admin/v1) with phone-OTP and admin email+password+email-OTP auth, JWT access + rotating refresh tokens, settings registry, append-only audit, notifications, uploads, provider ports with fakes, OpenAPI + Postman generation with a contract guard, Docker, seeds and one sample `items` feature per namespace.
